comment: Words whose Slovak spelling does not encode Slovak pronunciation, or whose boundary no general rule can derive. Data layer, CC0-1.0 OR MIT.
lexicalized_stems_comment: Stems that open with a string identical to a productive prefix or a compositional first part, but where that element has lexicalized and no longer forms a morpheme boundary: ro-zum, not roz-um; ar-chív, not arch-ív, though arch-anjel keeps its seam. The distinction is etymological, so no rule derives it. Listing the stem covers every inflected and derived form built on it (obed -> obeda, obedovať, obedný).
foreign_nucleus_spellings_comment: Stem openings whose adjacent vowel letters form one nucleus in Slovak pronunciation. The spelling alone cannot distinguish these from a hiatus; a stem covers its inflected forms.
